feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Greetings from Syria, where time seems to melt as a glassmaker braves scorching temps
entry.summary: As a Syrian glassmaker created his wares in Damascus, watching his craft reminded this reporter to slow down and enjoy the moment.

entry.title: Police questioning can shape a sexual assault case. Their approach is often wrong
entry.summary: The Cornell lawsuit filed by a woman alleging a brutal rape raises questions on how police handle such cases. The majority of police lack adequate training on trauma-informed approaches, experts say.

entry.title: Trump officials changed forms for overseas voters amid a GOP push to restrict voting
entry.summary: The Pentagon made last-minute changes to forms that many overseas U.S. citizens use for absentee voting, removing a category of citizens that Republicans have been pushing to block from voting.

entry.title: How Ukrainians are coping with new, more deadly Russian attacks
entry.summary: Zanny Minton Beddoes, The Economist's editor in chief, just visited Ukraine. She says, despite all its drone weaponry, Kyiv is under extraordinary bombardment, as Russia tries to make it unlivable.

entry.title: How Trump keeps undercutting his anti-communist message
entry.summary: The Trump administration has taken government equity stakes in more than three dozen private companies.

entry.title: After failed execution, health workers say Tennessee's method flouts medical ethics
entry.summary: After a botched lethal injection in May, dozens of Tennessee medical professionals told the governor that healthcare professionals shouldn't help with executions, no matter the method.

entry.title: A pilot stabs another pilot and tries to crash their flight to Tel Aviv, Israel says
entry.summary: As the plane went into a spin and began to plunge, a passenger and crew members got into the cockpit, subdued the pilot and diverted the flight to land in Saudi Arabia, Israel's leader says.

entry.title: FBI hunting the hackers who stole its employees' sensitive data
entry.summary: The FBI says it's addressing a massive data breach, vowing to go after the hackers it believes are responsible.

entry.title: U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
entry.summary: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.

entry.title: Travel plans? Here's what to know as measles exposures reach trains and games
entry.summary: Measles is traveling, with outbreaks in Pennsylvania, Ohio and New York, and exposures on transportation and in sports. What should you know before getting on a plane or train?
